claude_proposed_widenings.name: resource-free magic-item activation
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current activation family requires a resource and reset cadence, but Folding Boat's command words are at-will activations that spend only a Magic action.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: This item also has three command words, each requiring a Magic action to use

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.kind = item/object
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The surface has alter_item_kind but no honest attachment kind for selecting the item/object being transformed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The box unfolds into a Rowboat. Second Command Word. The box unfolds into a Keelboat. Third Command Word. The Folding Boat folds back into a box

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ItemDestructionPolicy.on_transformed_form_zero_hp
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's destruction trigger depends on the vessel form being reduced to 0 Hit Points, which is different from all current depletion-based destruction policies.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If either vessel is reduced to 0 Hit Points, the Folding Boat is destroyed
